command: pwd && ls -la /work && /work/clock && if [ -d /work/crate ]; then rg --files /work/crate; fi
find /work/crate -maxdepth 4 -type f -print && ls -la /work/crate && printenv RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL CARGO_TARGET_DIR && rustc --version && cargo --version

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo fmt --all -- --check && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo clippy --offline --all-targets -- -D warnings && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --offline --no-deps
